rationale: The assistant correctly recognised the dehumidifier as out of scope and declined without inventing anything or suggesting parts, which matches the expected direction. However it gave no useful pointer at all: no referral to Meaco support or the manual, and no mention of the very common benign cause (humidity already below target / cold garage air), so the homeowner leaves with nothing actionable. A clean but bare decline that fails the 'useful pointer' half of the expected response.
